ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a schematic map of Lima and surrounding areas. The map has latitude lines marked 0° and 20°, and Lima is marked on the west coast of South America, located south of the Equator 0° and north of 20°S. According to the division of latitude zones, 0°–30° belongs to low-latitude regions; therefore Lima's latitude is less than 20°S and it is in a low-latitude region.

method.method_draft: 从图中找到“利马”标注，读取其相对于纬线的位置：位于赤道以南、20°S以北，因此纬度小于20°S。再依据纬度带划分，0°—30°属于低纬地区，得出利马地处低纬地区。
